dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged light-colored perimeters forming interlocking 'O' and 'C' shapes across the dorsal-lateral mid-section, exhibiting sharp pixel intensity transitions from near-white boundaries to dark gray interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of low-intensity (dark) irregular polygons enclosed by the high-contrast light lattice, particularly concentrated in the upper-mid dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A triangular arrangement of three primary ring centroids located on the upper flank, with the apex pointing toward the posterior and the base parallel to the anterior-posterior axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense, low-intensity (near black) facial mask covering the snout and ocular region, providing high contrast against the lighter patterned dorsal fur.
